thread_analysis.thread_summary: Toitec Corporation (contact Takashi Kurokawa) completes Bluetooth SIG registration support with Allion (Itsuo Sakai, Toshitaka Mochizuki, Masaya Iida). The thread covers final Review Page confirmation, registration confirmation (Submission) with the server-issued SDoC attached, and the Compliance Folder (CD-R) shipment notification with standard retention-duty and free-derivative-model-addition explanations.
all_questions_found: (Customer confirmation, not a substantive question) Is the Review Page content acceptable to proceed with final registration confirmation?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: This thread is primarily an operational notification chain (Review Page approval, Submission confirmation with SDoC delivery, Compliance Folder CD-R shipment) rather than a technical Q&A. The Compliance Folder retention-duty explanation (retain 1 year after the last listed product's sale ends, present only if SIG audits; audits are rare in Allion's registration-support history) and the free derivative-model addition mechanism (same-SoC future models added via Manage Submitted Products in My Page, using the provided addition procedure document) match the standard policy already documented in detail in earlier threads (e.g. thread_0220_case_03, thread_0220_case_04).
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Same as previously documented: Compliance Folder retention is a standing obligation independent of whether an audit ever occurs; derivative models sharing the same SoC as an existing registration can be added for free via self-service web operations.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: See prior threads (e.g. thread_0220) for the risk of customers misunderstanding Compliance Folder retention timing or derivative-model addition mechanics.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: This thread does not introduce new technical or consulting content beyond the standard post-registration completion notification template (Review Page approval → Submission/SDoC → Compliance Folder CD-R shipment with retention-duty and free-addition explanations) already documented in prior threads. No case files were created to avoid duplicating that existing documentation.
